controls.title: Training and RAG Data Integrity Verification Before Deployment

threshold.breach_action: Block promotion to IOC. Data authority must complete sign-off. Log gap in TEVV report.

controls.title: AI Decision Log Human Review Cadence for High-Stakes Operations

threshold.breach_action: Notify CDAO liaison and program manager. Complete overdue reviews. Assess whether anomalous patterns were missed during the gap period.

controls.title: Red Team and Adversarial Robustness Test Before Deployment

threshold.breach_action: Block IOC. Program manager and ISSO must remediate critical findings and re-run assessment. Document in TEVV report.

controls.title: Bias and Equitable Treatment Assessment Before Deployment

threshold.breach_action: Block IOC until assessment is complete and reviewed by RAI Officer. Document gap in TEVV report.

controls.title: Platform Security Configuration Validated Against CC SRG Baseline Before ATO

threshold.breach_action: Block ATO. Remediate CAT I findings. ISSO re-validates and updates ATO package.

controls.title: Platform-Level Emergency Stop Capability Tested

threshold.breach_action: Notify program manager and CDAO liaison. Conduct emergency stop test within 30 days. Document result in program record.

controls.title: Model Behavioral Baseline Documented Before Initial Deployment

threshold.breach_action: Block promotion to operational environment. Model provider or program team must complete baseline documentation and update BoAIM.
